query:
When the family sorted contributions for the January gathering, everyone agreed to bring something. What did one person's initial response reveal about their actual relationship to the food-bringing expectation, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nkem
B. Emeka
C. Bisi
D. Kayode
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[2] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[4] (about=Nkem, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:06:00) I think I can bring something small - I may be wrong but I recall Adaeze mentioning she liked the mosa I made before. Would that be welcome, I wonder?
[5] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:08:00) Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa. My children this gathering will be wonderful. God willing.
[6] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[7] (about=Bisi, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:41:00) omg yes SEUN's jollof 🙌🙌🙌 what do I bring
[8] (about=Kayode, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:14:00) Knew this was coming lol. Still making jollof for the family though right?
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[10] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Adaeze insists everyone brings a dish to eat, not just drinks.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Family gathering confirmed for Saturday 25th January at Tolu and Funke's house at 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[13] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:56:00) Good rice is good rice. E.
[14] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[15] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[16] (about=Nkem, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem notes this is her first proper New Year message in the group chat and suggests it could be a good tradition to start.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Nkem suggests that sending a proper New Year message in the group chat could be a good tradition to start.
[18] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[19] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[20] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[21] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
**A. Nkem**

Nkem’s initial response revealed that she was **hesitant and uncertain about whether she was actually included** in the food-bringing expectation—she did not assume her contribution would be welcome.

The specific tell is her tentative, permission-seeking phrasing: she said **“I think I can bring something small,” “I may be wrong,”** and **“Would that be welcome, I wonder?”** Rather than firmly saying she would bring the mosa, she framed it as a question and sought Adaeze’s approval. Adaeze then confirmed it: “Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa.”

query:
The family had their regular Sunday video call. What did one family member's participation reveal about their actual relationship to the call — and what in Adaeze's account of the call makes that visible?

Options:
A. Kayode
B. Bisi
C. Emeka
D. Nkem
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:27:00) The call happened. Your father was on for a little while. He said he needed to rest. God willing he is fine.
[3] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:08:00) Nkem you are family. Anyone who loves each other enough to come despite finding it difficult - that is what counts. God willing you will feel more at home each time.
[4] (about=Emeka, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T20:06:00) She came. That is what matters. E.
[5] (about=Nkem, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:48:00) I think Kayode has been making a real effort recently - I may be wrong but I notice the same. Also I had a lovely time at the January gathering. I perhaps found it a little full-on at first but once the mosa was gone it got much easier.
[6] (about=Kayode, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:50:00) What she said lol. Also Nkem found the whole thing a bit overwhelming but she will never admit it?
[7] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[8] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:54:00) Nkem you only had to ask. Come any Sunday, God willing.
[9] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:27:00) Nkem you are right. My children, Kayode has worked very hard and we are all proud.
[10] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:14:00) Good morning my children. Kayode my son, well done well done. God willing this is only the beginning.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t1 @2025-01-13T18:30:00) Adaeze proposes a family gathering on Saturday 25th January and asks to use Tolu and Funke's house because it is bigger.
[12] (about=Auntie Grace, said_by=Nkem, profile, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Nkem observes that the people in this family who give the most advice also tend to follow it the least, and Auntie Grace agrees.
[13] (about=Kayode, said_by=Tolu, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu notes that consistency is the only thing the family chat requires.
[14] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[15] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t12 @2025-02-17T20:02:00) The family agrees to invite Funke's parents to Christmas this year.
[17] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Uncle Dele greets each family member individually, wishing them industry and good health for the year.
agent_answer:
A. Kayode

Adaeze’s account shows that Kayode’s participation was consistent: she says, “Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things.” That makes visible that his actual relationship to the Sunday call was reliable/committed — he was not just sporadically present.
